pages.what: The list and the baseline in one: Completion and Baseline cards, chips, one filter row (search, families dropdown, five filters), 50 rows a page; a row goes to the control's page, its eye previews it.

The control's page: one primary (its next step), Status, Implementation by component, Requirements, Evidence, Objectives, Findings and risks; Details and the provider at the side; its place in the filtered list with Previous and Next.
A control on a component: crumbs System › subsystem › component › control, the sidebar on System, that component's implementation first and whole, primary Write or Edit implementation.
Coverage, the list's second view: components by control family in objectives mapped; a cell opens what stands there.
The workbook, unchanged inside; it carries the List · Workbook switch; a row's control previews over it, and ↗ keeps Back to the workbook.
The same record as a preview (a row's eye): every section and action of the page in 520px.

folded.kept: The six layers in order with what each added and removed, each a filter; Edit baseline with switches, Add overlay, What changes.
folded.dropped: The stack table's Owner and Last changed columns, the status strip and the 18 family tiles: the rail and the Completion card say them.

folded.kept: The 17 listed parameters, on their controls: values print in the statement and are set there with a rationale. The address opens the nine controls that have them.
folded.dropped: The 1,048-row register and its Read by a check column: only 17 rows ever existed.

folded.kept: A layer's added and removed controls, as rows: the Baseline card's line filters to them.
folded.dropped: The layer's own page and its Already selected list; its address is not redirected (records layer).

folded.kept: The 14 techniques as the Technique filter; the address opens the controls that support any (Table E-1, lane X's reading).
folded.dropped: The goals, objectives and approaches ladder, Replay layers and the per-technique preview with counts by layer.

folded.kept: The matrix of components by family in objectives mapped, heatmap or table, each cell opening its preview.
folded.dropped: The band of four numbers and its three other readings; lane X's columns by resiliency technique. Needs evidence is a chip; issues and risks are Findings and Risks.

folded.kept: Status, responsibility with the provider's statement and the not authorized word (lane W), the finding and campaign behind the status and Determined by (lane F), the next step.
folded.dropped: Nothing a person used; its Change and Map a requirement dialogs are the panel's own now.

folded.kept: Implementation, requirements, evidence, objectives one by one, findings: all on the control's one page.
folded.dropped: SI-2's hand-made tabs (Checks, History, Comments) and its STIG rules table.

walks.title: Baseline and controls are one page

steps.see: Completion 41% and a Baseline card: six layers, 370 to 560; one filter row; 50 of 560 rows.
steps.was: Controls drew 17 of 560; the layers were on a separate Baseline page.

steps.do: In the Family filter choose AC · Access Control, then in Status choose No evidence.
steps.see: The same page, 52 then fewer rows, in one row of filters; search, the pager and Clear work.
steps.was: A family tile opened Controls with nothing selected; search and pager were dead.

steps.do: Clear filters; on the Baseline card choose the line CNSSI 1253.
steps.see: The 200 controls it added still in the baseline, then the 16 it removed, each with Restore.
steps.was: A layer was a page of code pills.

steps.do: Add control, From the catalog; search SC-7(20), tick it; write a rationale; Add 1 control.
steps.see: 561 on both cards; Program tailoring reads +15; SC-7(20) is listed, Source Program tailoring.

steps.do: Edit baseline; switch Mission Assurance Overlay off; read What changes; Apply to the baseline.
steps.see: 561 now, 566 after, AC-18 and its four enhancements return; the line reads Not applied.
steps.was: Edit overlays opened with an overlay nobody added and saved nothing.

steps.do: Search AC-22, choose its row; on its page More, Remove from the baseline, with a rationale.
steps.see: The page says Tailored out with Restore to the baseline; back on Controls one fewer, AC-22 under Tailored out.

walks.title: Work a control on its page

steps.do: On Controls search AC-2 and choose its row.
steps.see: Its page: Status, then Implementation with one row a component, Requirements, Evidence, 26 Objectives; one primary.
steps.was: A preview with no implementation; the page behind it was read-only.

steps.do: Choose the Mission Computer row; set Implemented; write how it implements AC-2; Save.
steps.see: The text and status on the row; kept after a reload.
steps.was: One narrative for the whole system, editable only in the SSP after accepting an AI draft.

steps.do: System, Mission Computer, Controls; choose AC-2's row.
steps.see: System › Mission Computing Subsystem › Mission Computer › AC-2; Mission Computer's implementation first; Edit implementation.
steps.was: The component page said Open in Controls, which opened the whole register.

steps.do: On Controls open SA-24; press Add requirement, then Create requirement; fill and create.
steps.see: A new requirement maps it; No requirement becomes No evidence; the primary becomes Add evidence.
steps.was: Map a requirement was a dialog offering three fixed requirements.

steps.do: Press Add evidence; choose an artifact; Add evidence.
steps.see: Not assessed; the primary becomes the assessment step.
steps.was: Link evidence offered six fixed artifacts.

steps.do: In the view menu choose No requirement, then the first row; on its page press Next.
steps.see: 1 of 14 in Controls: No requirement, then the next control's page; the breadcrumb returns to the same list.
steps.was: Each control was a preview over a 17-row list.

steps.do: Open AC-11; choose the placeholder in its statement; set 15 minutes.
steps.see: The statement prints 15 minutes of inactivity.
steps.was: Parameters were a separate tab of Baseline.

steps.do: On Controls choose Workbook beside the title; edit a Narrative cell; Review changes; Apply; choose List.
steps.see: One click each way; the list's row reads the text applied in the workbook.
steps.was: The workbook was a secondary button, with no switch back.

shots.title: Baseline and Controls are one page
shots.caption: The stack table and 18 family tiles become one Baseline card on Controls; a family is a filter in the list's row.

shots.title: All 560, filtered in place
shots.caption: 17 sample rows with dead search and pager become the whole baseline: one row of search, views and filters, 50 a page.

shots.title: The control's page is where the work is
shots.caption: The read-only preview becomes a page: AC-2 on Mission Computer, its implementation written, crumbs back to the component.

shots.title: Tailoring works, and says what changes
shots.caption: A read-only layer of code pills becomes Edit baseline: a switch a layer and What changes before Apply.

shots.title: The workbook is Controls' second view
shots.caption: The workbook carries the List · Workbook switch and says it holds the same 560 controls.

open: The view switch sits beside the title, not at the filter row's end.
Under 1680px the provider under Responsibility and the owner's name are hidden (avatar only); under 1400px the Components column too.
Components and Implementation are one table (one row a component, with Add component and Remove); its count is its rows, the system's own row included.
A row's grey line is the SSP's implementation narrative ('Implementation not written' for the 74 placeholders): the prototype holds no catalog statement text.
The statement prints only for the nine controls whose parameters v2 listed; their sentences are abridged catalog text authored in this module. Where one exists it leads the page, before Status.
Add control lists 144 catalog controls with a reason to be there; any other joins by code. The catalog's 1,014 titles are private to the wizard.
A control tailored in today is in the list, the cards and the facts, not in PA.SSP.controls: the SSP and the workbook keep 560 rows, and the workbook says so.
Edit baseline applies at once and says the open assessments keep their baseline; nothing is held as a draft.
Evidence rows go to artifact--<id> only where lane D holds an artifact of that title; the register's unnamed 'Evidence for REQ-…' rows stay still (no page, no eye).
Findings and risks has no Add of its own: a finding comes from an assessment (the next step), a risk from a finding (lane E).
A control on a component marks System in the sidebar and its crumbs lead to the component's Controls tab; without lane S it falls back to Controls.
The page's place in the list follows whatever the list was last filtered or searched by, including a search left in the box.

In the workbook only Implementation and Narrative take edits (its module is not this lane's); the walk edits a cell at 1440 only. The grid does not redraw after a preview edit until the workbook is reopened.
Objectives read Judged for every objective once the control's count says all are judged; lane F's per-objective records are used only for a control judged in part.

Another program: a created program draws its own baseline with Add control and Remove a control; its rows open lane P's preview, with no control page. The created-program steps of the walk run at 1440 only.
If a program was created earlier in the session and the page is reloaded before Controls was ever opened, the reference baseline's membership may not be readable (not seen in the walk).

Found by the re-walk, not fixed: the Controls list keeps its search and filters when you leave and come back, so it can open on a narrowed list ("All 0") without saying why; after Add control it stays narrowed to Program tailoring.
Found by the re-walk, not fixed: in the workbook a record's code opens the side panel, not the record's page; the page is a second click.

Pass 3, check: views.mjs prints 14 passed, 3 failed on controls with the seeded saved view (AC: needs evidence). All three are the script counting Manage views' rows as 1 after a save and 0 after a delete, and renaming the first row; a seeded list has 2 then 1. With the seed taken out it prints 17 passed, 0 failed. The seed is kept, as PASS3 asks.

Pass 3, kit: a column's cls "wrap" and cls "main" also match the page shell's .wrap and .main in core.css (display: grid; .wrap has a 72px gap), so a wrapping cell stacks what it holds. Worked around for the implementation statement's column with a class of this lane (k3c-stm: display: table-cell; width: 100%).

Pass 3, kit: in a preview the short list's first column keeps the pages' 200px floor at 760px and under (the kit's own .k3-pk min-width: 0 is beaten by the first-column rule), so a name beside a wide pill scrolls sideways at 390. Worked around for this lane's five sections by their ids.

Pass 3, not done: under 1360px wide the Controls row falls back to the kit's wrapping (two rows at 1280). From 1360 to 1559 it stays one row by cutting the chosen filters' values with an ellipsis and hiding Clear (the views menu's All controls clears).

Pass 3, decisions that cut something: Technique is no longer a filter of its own but a second group inside Family (the filter then reads Technique: Segmentation), so a family and a technique cannot be chosen together. A row's grey words now name a gap only (Implementation not written); the cut-off statement is gone from the list and from a requirement's row. The preview's lists no longer carry Unmap and Remove: both are on the control's page. A provider that is not authorized is a dotted underline and a tooltip on the row (and Responsibility: Provider not authorized as a filter); under 1680px the row shows Hybrid or Inherited alone.

Pass 3, not done: a set another page names (a component's controls, the controls an SSP section cites, the controls with parameters) heads the table as one band with Show every control; it is not a control of the row and no saved view keeps it.
